run_cvt_conv_benchmark: run the pytorch benchmark for CvT convolutional projection and token embedding layers on cpu or gpu
run_benchmark_requests: run benchmark_requests to measure average or median latency of a callable across a list of tensor inputs
create_cvt_convolutional_projection: create a cvt_convolutional_projection module using dw_bn depthwise convolution or avg pooling method
create_cvt_convolutional_token_embedding: create a cvt_convolutional_token_embedding module to project image patches into convolutional embeddings with optional normalization
run_layer_benchmark: run the run function to benchmark a conv_proj or patch_embed layer and return elapsed time bytes and flops
